create.name: Istituto Samantabhadra
create.bio:
Istituto Samantabhadra is a Rome centre for the study and practice of Mahayana Buddhism in the Tibetan Gelugpa tradition, founded in 1981 by Geshe Jampel Senghe, a scholar trained at Sera monastery. After his death that year Dagpo Rinpoche, long a lecturer at the Sorbonne in Paris, became its spiritual guide. Resident geshes have taught there since 1985, the most recent being Geshe Dorjee Wangchuk, who led the institute from 2018 until July 2026. It was among the founders of the Italian Buddhist Union, runs without profit on members' fees and donations, and also works to keep Tibetan culture alive through language lessons, music, exhibitions and talks, as well as humanitarian projects for Tibetans.

Its teaching centres on the gradual path: for years a geshe has taught the Lam Rim Chen Mo of Tsongkhapa on Tuesday evenings, translated from Tibetan and streamed on Zoom, and the institute has published a full Italian translation of the text in three volumes. Alongside this it holds introductions to Buddhism, basic meditation courses, Tara prayers, tsog offerings and residential retreats. In 2026 it moved to new premises on Via della Magliana. Its long-running YouTube channel carries hundreds of recorded Lam Rim classes, mind-training and calm-abiding sessions, and festival-day practices.

courses.title: Lam Rim Chen Mo
courses.description: A weekly Tuesday-evening study of Tsongkhapa's Great Treatise on the Stages of the Path, taught by the resident geshe with translation from Tibetan, in person on booking and online via Zoom.

courses.title: Corsi e Attività
courses.description: Residential Dharma and meditation retreats, courses in basic meditation techniques and in the Tibetan language, events on Buddhism and Tibetan culture, and pujas and ceremonies on request.

courses.title: Come frequentare l'istituto
courses.description: Annual membership of the association, which is required to take part in the institute's activities; teachings themselves are offered for a voluntary donation.

flags: Centre in transition: the resident teacher Geshe Dorjee Wangchuk led it only until July 2026, it moved to Via della Magliana 582 with reopening planned for October 2026, and the programme page still shows April–May 2026. No dated offerings after 12 Nov; Lam Rim item listed undated. Latest upload 23 Jun 2026.

Founder Geshe Jampel Senghe is described as a direct disciple of Pabongka Rinpoche. The site follows the Dalai Lama and Dagpo Rinpoche and makes no mention of Dorje Shugden; no sign of Shugden practice.

Health rule: the courses page also lists shiatsu and foot reflexology courses, and the April programme had a 'Check-up della mente' on degenerative diseases of the mind with cognitive screening; all left out. Yoga for beginners also not listed.
Course enquiries use istitutosamantabhadra@gmail.com; the secretariat email on the contact page is used.
Video titles are bare dates/labels as uploaded (e.g. 'LAMRIM', 'SHINE 30112025').
Teachers (Dagpo Rinpoche, Geshe Dorjee Wangchuk) are not on Spiritpedia; teachers file empty. The Dalai Lama appears on the 'Maestri' page as the tradition's head, not as a teacher there.
Edizioni Samantabhadra's three-volume Italian Lam Rim Chen Mo not looked up (Amazon not fetched).
